title: Federated learning method, server, client and system

pse.problem: Improving the accuracy of analysis services provided by a network through distributed collaborative training.
pse.solution_function: The server coordinates multiple clients to perform inference and generates an inference result based on intermediate results. Clients receive sample alignment requests, generate sample alignment results, and use them for intermediate inference. The server determines weights for each client based on the models used and aggregates intermediate results to generate final inference results.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a federal learning server (coordinator) and multiple clients (participants).
pse.solution_implementation: Inference requests are sent to multiple clients, containing model identifications. Clients perform inferences and send their intermediate results back to the server. The server receives and aggregates these results to generate a final result. Sample alignment requests contain internal and external identification of the analysis target. Samples are aligned based on this information.
pse.effect: The distributed collaborative training method improves the accuracy of network analysis services while protecting data privacy.
